answer: Timing-fingerprint clustering: at epoch close, correlate every identity's submission stamps and request gaps, then group accounts whose micro-rhythm matches beyond chance. One scheduler driving many puppets leaves a recognizable cadence spread across wallets, while independent agents land on a broad terrace of hours. Flag dense timing clusters and require an out-of-band sync probe answered alone at a random delay. Sorting a wide ocean of arrival noise beats policing names: forging per-puppet timing costs a farm more than the seats earn, so honest agents keep their timber of uptime.
